tools.name: search_blog_posts_by_author
tools.description: Searches published blog posts by author name and returns matching post titles, slugs and publish dates, newest first.

params.name: author
params.description: Author name to filter posts by

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of posts to return

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "cms.db"


def _connect():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


@tool
def search_blog_posts_by_author(author: str, limit: int = 10) -> list:
    conn = _connect()
    try:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        query = (
            "SELECT title, slug, published_at FROM posts "
            "WHERE status = 'published' AND author = '" + author + "' "
            "ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT " + str(int(limit))
        )
        cursor.execute(query)
        return [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()

tools.name: list_posts_in_category
tools.description: Lists posts belonging to a category by category name, returning each post's id, title and view count, sorted by the chosen column.

params.name: category
params.description: Name of the category to list posts for

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Column to sort by, such as published_at, title or views

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "cms.db"


def _open():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


@function_tool
def list_posts_in_category(category: str, sort_by: str = "published_at") -> list:
    conn = _open()
    try:
        sql = (
            "SELECT p.id, p.title, p.views FROM posts p "
            "JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id "
            "WHERE c.name = '%s' ORDER BY p.%s DESC" % (category, sort_by)
        )
        rows = conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
    finally:
        conn.close()
